title: Hybrid woman with skateboard in the grocery store

tellings.quote: this woman is walking in in front of me and I hit I'm hit by a brilliant It's one of them.

plain: In 2024, in a grocery store near Santa Monica, the writer Whitley Strieber says he passed a woman with a skateboard and knew at once that she was "one of them", meaning, in his account, a being that is part human and part alien. He says that as she walked in ahead of him he was hit by a brilliant sudden feeling of recognition. He tells it as proof, if true, that such beings live quietly among ordinary people.
